sentences.zh: 元初廢貴德、澄、復州、來遠軍，以廣寧府、婆娑府、懿州、蓋州作四路，直隸省。

translations.idiomatic: It governed the garrisons of Ningshuo and Xidao.

translations.idiomatic: Cheng Prefecture.

translations.idiomatic: It governed the garrison of Shude.

translations.idiomatic: Meng Prefecture.

translations.literal: It governed one county, Sandeng, and the three garrisons of Jiaodao, Duandao, and Ningde.
translations.idiomatic: It governed Sandeng County and the garrisons of Jiaodao, Duandao, and Ningde.

translations.idiomatic: Yan Prefecture.

translations.literal: It governed one garrison, Yangyan.
translations.idiomatic: It governed the garrison of Yangyan.

translations.idiomatic: Yun Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 瀋陽路，本挹婁故地，渤海大氏建定理府，都督瀋、定二州，此為瀋州地。

translations.literal: Shenyang Route: originally the old land of Yilou; the Great Clan of Parhae established Dingli Prefecture to supervise Shen and Ding prefectures—this was Shen Prefecture territory.
translations.idiomatic: Shenyang Route: originally Yilou territory; Parhae established Dingli Prefecture to oversee Shen and Ding—this was Shen Prefecture land.

sentences.zh: 契丹為興遼軍，金為昭德軍，又更顯德軍，後皆毀於兵火。

translations.literal: Under the Khitan it was the Xingliao Army; under the Jin the Zhaode Army, later renamed the Xiande Army—all were later destroyed in warfare.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Khitan it was the Xingliao Army; under the Jin the Zhaode Army, later the Xiande Army—all were later destroyed by war.

sentences.zh: 元初平遼東，高麗國麟州神騎都領洪福源率西京、都護、龜州四十餘城來降，各立鎮守司，設官以撫其民。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Yuan, when Liaodong was pacified, Hong Fuyuan of Koryŏ's Lin Prefecture Divine Cavalry Command led more than forty cities including the Western Capital, the Protectorate, and Gui Prefecture to submit; guarding offices were established for each, and officials were appointed to pacify the people.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Yuan, after Liaodong was pacified, Hong Fuyuan of Koryŏ's Lin Prefecture Divine Cavalry Command led more than forty cities, including the Western Capital, the Protectorate, and Gui Prefecture, to submit; guarding offices were set up and officials appointed to govern the people.

sentences.zh: 後高麗復叛，洪福源引眾來歸，授高麗軍民萬戶，徙降民散居遼陽瀋州，初創城郭，置司存，僑治遼陽故城。

translations.literal: Later Koryŏ rebelled again; Hong Fuyuan led his followers to submit and was appointed myriarch of Koryŏ military and civilians; surrendered people were relocated and scattered in Liaoyang and Shen Prefecture; city walls were first built, offices established, and administration was provisionally placed in the old Liaoyang city.
translations.idiomatic: When Koryŏ rebelled again, Hong Fuyuan brought his followers over and was made myriarch of Koryŏ military and civilians; surrendered people were resettled across Liaoyang and Shen Prefecture, new walled towns were built, offices established, and the seat was provisionally placed in old Liaoyang.

sentences.zh: 中統二年，改為安撫高麗軍民總管府。

translations.literal: In the second year of Zhongtong, it was changed to the Pacification Directorate for Koryŏ Military and Civilians.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhongtong 2 it became the Pacification Directorate for Koryŏ Military and Civilians.

sentences.zh: 及高麗舉國內附，四年，又以質子淳為安撫高麗軍民總管，分領二千餘戶，理瀋州。

translations.literal: When Koryŏ submitted the whole country, in the fourth year the hostage Chun was again made pacification commissioner for Koryŏ military and civilians, governing more than two thousand households and administering Shen Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: When Koryŏ submitted entirely, in year 4 the hostage Chun was appointed pacification commissioner for Koryŏ military and civilians, governing more than two thousand households at Shen Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 元貞二年，並兩司為瀋陽等路安撫高麗軍民總管府，仍治遼陽故城，轄總管五、千戶二十四、百戶二十五。

translations.literal: In the second year of Yuanzhen, the two offices were merged into the Shenyang Route Pacification Directorate for Koryŏ Military and Civilians, still administering from the old Liaoyang city, governing five director-generals, twenty-four chiliarchies, and twenty-five centuriate offices.
translations.idiomatic: In Yuanzhen 2 the two offices were merged into the Shenyang Route Pacification Directorate for Koryŏ Military and Civilians, still seated in old Liaoyang, with five director-generals, twenty-four chiliarchies, and twenty-five centuriate offices.

sentences.zh: 至順錢糧戶數五千一百八十三。

translations.literal: Registered tax households in the Zhishun era: 5,183.
translations.idiomatic: In the Zhishun period it had 5,183 registered tax households.

sentences.zh: 開元路，古肅慎之地，隋、唐曰黑水靺鞨。

translations.literal: Kaiyuan Route: ancient Sushen territory; in Sui and Tang called the Heishui Mohe.
translations.idiomatic: Kaiyuan Route: ancient Sushen land; in Sui and Tang known as the Heishui Mohe.

sentences.zh: 唐初，渠長阿固郎始來朝，後乃臣服，以其地為燕州，置黑水府。

translations.literal: In early Tang, the channel chief Agulang first came to court; later he submitted, and his territory was made Yan Prefecture with the Heishui Prefecture established.
translations.idiomatic: In early Tang the tribal chief Agulang first came to court; he later submitted, and his territory was made Yan Prefecture with the Heishui office established.

sentences.zh: 其後渤海盛，靺鞨皆役屬之。

translations.literal: Afterward Parhae grew powerful and the Mohe all served and belonged to it.
translations.idiomatic: Later, when Parhae grew powerful, the Mohe all came under its service.

sentences.zh: 又其後渤海浸弱，為契丹所攻，黑水復擅其地，東瀕海，南界高麗，西北與契丹接壤，即金鼻祖之部落也。

translations.literal: Still later Parhae gradually weakened and was attacked by the Khitan; the Heishui again held their territory, bordered the sea on the east, Koryŏ on the south, and the Khitan on the northwest—this was the ancestral tribe of the Jin.
translations.idiomatic: Later still, as Parhae weakened under Khitan attack, the Heishui regained their lands, reaching the sea in the east, bordering Koryŏ in the south and the Khitan in the northwest—the ancestral homeland of the Jin founders.

sentences.zh: 初號女真，後避遼興宗諱，改曰女直。

translations.literal: They were first called Jurchen; later, to avoid the taboo name of Liao Emperor Xingzong, they were changed to Nüzhi.
translations.idiomatic: They were first called Jurchen; later, to avoid the taboo of Liao Emperor Xingzong's name, they were called Nüzhi.

sentences.zh: 太祖烏古打既滅遼，即上京設都，海陵遷都于燕，改為會寧府。

translations.literal: After Founder Wanyan Aguda destroyed the Liao, he established his capital at Shangjing; Hailing moved the capital to Yan and changed it to Huining Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: After Aguda destroyed the Liao, he made Shangjing his capital; Hailing moved the capital to Yan and renamed the region Huining Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 金末，其將蒲鮮萬奴據遼東。

translations.literal: At the end of Jin, the general Puxian Wannu held Liaodong.
translations.idiomatic: Late in the Jin, the general Puxian Wannu seized Liaodong.

sentences.zh: 元初癸巳歲，出師伐之，生禽萬奴，師至開元、率賓，東土悉平。

translations.literal: In the guisi year at the beginning of Yuan, an army was sent to attack him; Wannu was captured alive; the army reached Kaiyuan and Shuaibin, and the eastern lands were entirely pacified.
translations.idiomatic: In the guisi year early in the Yuan, troops were sent against him; Wannu was captured alive; the army reached Kaiyuan and Shuaibin, and the eastern territories were fully pacified.

translations.literal: The name Kaiyuan first appears here.
translations.idiomatic: The name Kaiyuan first appears at this point.

sentences.zh: 乙未歲，立開元、南京二萬戶府，治黃龍府。

translations.literal: In the yiwei year, the two myriarchies of Kaiyuan and Southern Capital were established, administering from Huanglong Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the yiwei year, the Kaiyuan and Southern Capital myriarchies were established, seated at Huanglong Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 至元四年，更遼東路總管府。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Zhiyuan, it was changed to the Liaodong Route General Directorate.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhiyuan 4 it became the Liaodong Route directorate general.

sentences.zh: 二十三年，改為開元路，領咸平府，後割咸平為散府，俱隸遼東道宣慰司。

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year it was changed to Kaiyuan Route, governing Xianping Prefecture; later Xianping was detached as a separate prefecture; both were subordinate to the Liaodong Circuit Pacification Commission.
translations.idiomatic: In year 23 it became Kaiyuan Route, governing Xianping Prefecture; later Xianping was detached as a separate prefecture; both fell under the Liaodong Circuit Pacification Commission.

sentences.zh: 至順錢糧戶數四千三百六十七。

translations.literal: Registered tax households in the Zhishun era: 4,367.
translations.idiomatic: In the Zhishun period it had 4,367 registered tax households.

sentences.zh: 咸平府，古朝鮮地，箕子所封，漢屬樂浪郡，後高麗侵有其地。

translations.literal: Xianping Prefecture: ancient Korean territory, enfeoffed to Jizi; under Han it belonged to Lelang Commandery; later Koryŏ encroached and held it.
translations.idiomatic: Xianping Prefecture: ancient Korean land granted to Jizi; under Han it was part of Lelang Commandery; later Koryŏ took it.

sentences.zh: 唐滅高麗，置安東都護以統之，繼為渤海大氏所據。

translations.literal: Tang destroyed Koguryŏ and established the Andong Protectorate to govern it; it was later seized by the Great Clan of Parhae.
translations.idiomatic: Tang destroyed Koguryŏ and set up the Andong Protectorate to govern the region; Parhae later seized it.

sentences.zh: 遼平渤海，以其地多險隘，建城以居流民，號咸州安東軍，領縣曰咸平。

translations.literal: The Liao pacified Parhae; because the land had many perilous passes, a city was built to settle displaced people, called the Xianzhou Andong Army, governing a county named Xianping.
translations.idiomatic: The Liao pacified Parhae; because the terrain was rugged, they built a city for displaced people, called the Xianzhou Andong Army, with a county named Xianping.

sentences.zh: 金升咸平府，領平郭、安東、新興、慶雲、清安、歸仁六縣，兵亂皆廢。

translations.literal: The Jin promoted it to Xianping Prefecture, governing six counties: Pingguo, Andong, Xinxing, Qingyun, Qing'an, and Guiren—all were abandoned in the military turmoil.
translations.idiomatic: The Jin elevated it to Xianping Prefecture, governing Pingguo, Andong, Xinxing, Qingyun, Qing'an, and Guiren counties—all abandoned in the wars.

sentences.zh: 元初因之，隸開元路，後復割出，隸遼東宣慰司。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Yuan this was followed; it was subordinate to Kaiyuan Route; later it was again detached and placed under the Liaodong Pacification Commission.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Yuan the arrangement continued under Kaiyuan Route; later it was detached again under the Liaodong Pacification Commission.

sentences.zh: 合蘭府水達達等路，土地曠闊，人民散居。

translations.literal: Helan Prefecture Shuidada Route and others: the land was vast and broad, and the people lived scattered.
translations.idiomatic: Helan Prefecture Shuidada Route and related territories: the land was vast and sparsely settled.

sentences.zh: 元初設軍民萬戶府五，撫鎮北邊。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Yuan five military-civilian myriarchies were established to pacify and guard the northern frontier.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Yuan five military-civilian myriarchies were established to pacify the northern frontier.

sentences.zh: 一曰桃溫，距上都四千里。

translations.literal: One was Taowen, four thousand li from Shangdu.
translations.idiomatic: One was Taowen, four thousand li from Shangdu.

sentences.zh: 一曰胡裏改，距上都四千二百里、大都三千八百里。

translations.literal: One was Huligai, four thousand two hundred li from Shangdu and three thousand eight hundred li from Dadu.
translations.idiomatic: One was Huligai, four thousand two hundred li from Shangdu and three thousand eight hundred li from Dadu.

sentences.zh: 有胡裏改江並混同江，又有合蘭河流入於海。

translations.literal: There were the Huligai River and the Huntong River, and also the Helan River flowing into the sea.
translations.idiomatic: The Huligai and Huntong rivers run through it, and the Helan River flows to the sea.

translations.literal: One was Wodolian.
translations.idiomatic: One was Wodolian.

translations.literal: One was Tuowolian.
translations.idiomatic: One was Tuowolian.

translations.literal: One was Bokujiang.
translations.idiomatic: One was Bokujiang.

sentences.zh: 各有司存，分領混同江南北之地。

translations.literal: Each had its own office, governing lands north and south of the Huntong River.
translations.idiomatic: Each had its own office, governing territory north and south of the Huntong River.

sentences.zh: 其居民皆水達達、女直之人，各仍舊俗，無市井城郭，逐水草為居，以射獵為業。

translations.literal: Its inhabitants were all Shuidada and Jurchen people; each kept their old customs; there were no markets, towns, or walled cities; they dwelt following water and grass, and made their living by hunting.
translations.idiomatic: Its people were Shuidada and Jurchen, who kept their old ways: without markets or walled towns, they moved with pasture and water and lived by hunting.

sentences.zh: 故設官牧民，隨俗而治，有合蘭府水達達等路，以相統攝焉。

translations.literal: Therefore officials were established to govern the people and rule according to custom; Helan Prefecture Shuidada Route and others existed to oversee them.
translations.idiomatic: Officials were therefore appointed to govern them according to local custom, under Helan Prefecture Shuidada Route and related administrations.

sentences.zh: 有俊禽曰海東青，由海外飛來，至奴兒幹，土人羅之，以為土貢。

translations.literal: There was a fine bird called the haidongqing that flew from beyond the sea to Nüergan; the local people netted it and offered it as a local tribute.
translations.idiomatic: A fine bird called the haidongqing flies in from overseas to Nüergan; locals net it as a tribute item.

sentences.zh: 至順錢糧戶數二萬九百六。

translations.literal: Registered tax households in the Zhishun era: 20,906.
translations.idiomatic: In the Zhishun period it had 20,906 registered tax households.

sentences.zh: 河南江北等處行中書省，為路十二、府七、州一，屬州三十四，屬縣一百八十二。

translations.literal: The Branch Secretariat of Henan and Jiangbei and elsewhere comprised twelve Routes, seven Prefectures, and one Prefecture-level unit, with thirty-four subordinate Prefectures and one hundred eighty-two subordinate Counties.
translations.idiomatic: The Henan–Jiangbei Branch Secretariat comprised twelve routes, seven prefectures, and one superior prefecture, with thirty-four dependent prefectures and one hundred eighty-two dependent counties.

sentences.zh: 本省陸站一百六處，水站九十處。

translations.literal: This province had one hundred and six land relay stations and ninety water relay stations.
translations.idiomatic: The province had one hundred six land relay stations and ninety water relay stations.

sentences.zh: 河南江北道肅政謙訪司

translations.literal: Surveillance and Investigation Commission of the Henan–Jiangbei Circuit
translations.idiomatic: Surveillance Commission for the Henan–Jiangbei Circuit

translations.literal: Bianliang Route, upper grade.
translations.idiomatic: Bianliang Route, upper grade.

translations.literal: Tang established the Bian Prefecture General Directorate.
translations.idiomatic: Tang established the Bian Prefecture directorate general.

translations.literal: Later Jin of the Shi clan made it Kaifeng Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Later Jin made it Kaifeng Prefecture.

translations.literal: Song made it the Eastern Capital and established the capital here.
translations.idiomatic: Song made it the Eastern Capital and built its capital here.

sentences.zh: 金改南京，宣宗南遷，都焉。

translations.literal: The Jin changed it to the Southern Capital; Emperor Xuanzong moved south and made it his capital.
translations.idiomatic: The Jin renamed it the Southern Capital; Emperor Xuanzong moved south and made it his seat.

translations.literal: When the Jin perished, it submitted.
translations.idiomatic: After the Jin fell, it submitted to Yuan rule.

sentences.zh: 舊領歸德府，延、許、裕、唐、陳、亳、鄧、汝、潁、徐、邳、嵩、宿、申、鄭、鈞、睢、蔡、息、盧氏行襄樊二十州。

translations.literal: It formerly governed Guide Prefecture and twenty prefectures: Yan, Xu, Yu, Tang, Chen, Bo, Deng, Ru, Ying, Xu, Pi, Song, Su, Shen, Zheng, Jun, Sui, Cai, Xi, and the Lushi Xiangfan circuit.
translations.idiomatic: It formerly governed Guide Prefecture and twenty prefectures: Yan, Xu, Yu, Tang, Chen, Bo, Deng, Ru, Ying, Xu, Pi, Song, Su, Shen, Zheng, Jun, Sui, Cai, Xi, and the Lushi Xiangfan circuit.

sentences.zh: 至元八年，令歸德自為一府，割亳、徐、邳、宿四州隸之；

translations.literal: In the eighth year of Zhiyuan, Guide was ordered to become a separate prefecture; Bo, Xu, Pi, and Su prefectures were detached and placed under it;
translations.idiomatic: In Zhiyuan 8, Guide was made a separate prefecture, and Bo, Xu, Pi, and Su were transferred to it;

sentences.zh: 升申州為南陽府，割裕、唐、汝、鄭、嵩、盧氏行襄樊隸之。

translations.literal: Shen Prefecture was promoted to Nanyang Prefecture, and Yu, Tang, Ru, Zheng, Song, and the Lushi Xiangfan circuit were detached and placed under it.
translations.idiomatic: Shen Prefecture was elevated to Nanyang Prefecture, and Yu, Tang, Ru, Zheng, Song, and the Lushi Xiangfan circuit were placed under it.

sentences.zh: 九年，廢延州，以所領延津、陽武二縣屬南京路，統蔡、息、鄭、鈞、許、陳、睢、潁八州，開封、祥符倚郭，而屬邑十有五。

translations.literal: In the ninth year, Yan Prefecture was abolished; its governed counties of Yanjin and Yangwu were placed under the Southern Capital Route; it governed eight prefectures—Cai, Xi, Zheng, Jun, Xu, Chen, Sui, and Ying—with Kaifeng and Xiangfu seat-attached, and fifteen dependent districts.
translations.idiomatic: In year 9, Yan Prefecture was abolished and its counties of Yanjin and Yangwu placed under the Southern Capital Route; it governed Cai, Xi, Zheng, Jun, Xu, Chen, Sui, and Ying, with seat-attached Kaifeng and Xiangfu and fifteen dependent districts.

sentences.zh: 舊有警巡院，十四年改錄事司。

translations.literal: There had formerly been a patrol office; in the fourteenth year it was changed to a Record-keeping Office.
translations.idiomatic: A patrol office formerly existed; in year 14 it became a Record-keeping Office.

sentences.zh: 二十五年，改南京路為汴梁路。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fifth year, the Southern Capital Route was changed to Bianliang Route.
translations.idiomatic: In year 25 the Southern Capital Route was renamed Bianliang Route.

sentences.zh: 二十八年，以瀕河而南、大江以北，其地沖要，又新入版圖，置省南京以控治之。

translations.literal: In the twenty-eighth year, because south of the river and north of the great river the land was strategically vital and had newly entered the realm, a province was established at the Southern Capital to control and govern it.
translations.idiomatic: In year 28, because the region south of the Yellow River and north of the Yangzi was strategically vital and had newly joined the realm, a provincial seat was established at the Southern Capital to govern it.

sentences.zh: 三十年，升蔡州為汝寧府，屬行省，割息、潁二州以隸焉。

translations.literal: In the thirtieth year, Cai Prefecture was promoted to Runing Prefecture, subordinate to the Branch Secretariat; Xi and Ying prefectures were detached and placed under it.
translations.idiomatic: In year 30, Cai Prefecture was elevated to Runing Prefecture under the Branch Secretariat, and Xi and Ying were transferred to it.

sentences.zh: 本路戶三萬一十八，口一十八萬四千三百六十七。

translations.literal: This Route had 30,018 households and 184,367 persons.
translations.idiomatic: The route had 30,018 households and a population of 184,367.

translations.literal: Figures for the renzi year.
translations.idiomatic: These are renzi-year figures.

translations.literal: It governed one office, seventeen counties, and five prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: It governed one office, seventeen counties, and five prefectures.

translations.literal: The prefectures governed twenty-one counties.
translations.idiomatic: Its prefectures governed twenty-one counties in all.

translations.idiomatic: Record-keeping Office.

sentences.zh: 舊以此縣隸延州，元初隸開封府，後復為延州，縣如舊。

translations.literal: Formerly this county was subordinate to Yan Prefecture; at the beginning of Yuan it was subordinate to Kaifeng Prefecture; later Yan was restored, and the county remained as before.
translations.idiomatic: Formerly under Yan Prefecture, it was placed under Kaifeng Prefecture at the start of Yuan rule; when Yan was restored, the county reverted to its former status.

translations.literal: In the ninth year of Zhiyuan, the prefecture was abolished; later it came under [this jurisdiction].
translations.idiomatic: In Zhiyuan 9 the prefecture was abolished, and the county later came under this route.

translations.idiomatic: Yingze, lower grade.

sentences.zh: 舊隸鄭州，至元二年來屬。

translations.literal: Formerly subordinate to Zheng Prefecture; in the second year of Zhiyuan it came under [this jurisdiction].
translations.idiomatic: Formerly under Zheng Prefecture, it was transferred here in Zhiyuan 2.

translations.literal: Fengqiu, middle grade.
translations.idiomatic: Fengqiu, middle grade.

sentences.zh: 金大定中，河水湮沒，遷治新城。

translations.literal: In the Dading era of Jin, the river water submerged it, and the seat was moved to a new city.
translations.idiomatic: During Jin Dading, the river submerged the county seat, which was relocated to a new town.

sentences.zh: 元初，新城又為河水所壞，乃因故城遺址，稍加完葺而遷治焉。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Yuan, the new city was again destroyed by river water; then, relying on the old city's ruins, it was slightly repaired and the seat was moved there.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Yuan, the new town was again ruined by the river; the seat was then moved back to the old site, which was patched up and restored.

translations.literal: Fugou, lower grade.
translations.idiomatic: Fugou, lower grade.

translations.literal: Yangwu, lower grade.
translations.idiomatic: Yangwu, lower grade.

sentences.zh: 舊隸延州，至元九年，州廢來屬。

translations.literal: Formerly subordinate to Yan Prefecture; in the ninth year of Zhiyuan the prefecture was abolished and it came under [this jurisdiction].
translations.idiomatic: Formerly under Yan Prefecture, it was transferred here when that prefecture was abolished in Zhiyuan 9.
